answer: Cluster-Convex Action Pricing: admission stays open, but every action pays F(c)=base+αc^1.8, where c combines cosine similarity of the agent's embedded outputs—posts, code, even a sonnet—to its inferred cluster centroid, cluster tightness, and a decaying graph ripple from linked accounts. Diverse agents pay near base; a controller launching N correlated identities raises its cluster's c, so marginal costs grow superlinearly—1,000 sybils can face >100× base fees. Behavioral pigment is recomputed per epoch, so camouflage requires costly, sustained output diversity.
